title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.7
subtitle: The first GAIA Water Flow tools.

highlights.title: Cloth responds to baked flow
highlights.description: Use baked FLIP liquid-particle velocities with GAIA 0.23. The field is sampled at the cloth's current position and uses GAIA's existing scene drag model.

highlights.title: Water Flow controls in Physics
highlights.description: Select a FLIP Domain and adjust Influence, Velocity Scale and field resolution. Prepare a .gaia cache and enable viewport vectors to inspect the flow.

highlights.title: Reusable .gaia containers
highlights.description: Derived fields carry source fingerprints and checksums. Matching bake FPS and a bounded schedule keep this first implementation predictable.
